title: Reconstruction of finite Quasi-Probability and Probability from Principles: The Role of Syntactic Locality
summary: Quasi-probabilities appear across diverse areas of physics, but their conceptual foundations remain unclear: they are often treated merely as computational tools, and operations like conditioning and Bayes' theorem become ambiguous.
